daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are asking you to slow down and actually listen today. Your intuition is loud—trust it. There's magic in the pauses between your thoughts, so take some real breaths.
daily.love: Someone's been wanting to reach out. The universe is creating space for that conversation to happen naturally. Whether it's deepening something existing or opening a new door, stay open and authentic.
daily.career: Your creative energy is *chef's kiss* right now. If you've been sitting on an idea, today's the day to test it out. Don't wait for permission—your originality is exactly what's needed.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. A walk, some stretching, dancing to your favorite songs—anything that makes you feel alive in your skin. That's the energy shift you need.

weekly.overview: Your cosmic energy is shifting toward authenticity this week, Sag. Venus is whispering that it's time to stop performing and start being. Trust the plot twist headed your way—it's actually the upgrade you've been manifesting.
weekly.love: There's a magnetic pull happening in your connections. Whether you're coupled up or single, this is the universe saying: show up as your real self. Vulnerability isn't weakness; it's literally your superpower rn.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different this week. That project or proposal you've been sitting on? The energy supports you bringing it forward. Your natural confidence is magnetic—people are ready to co-create with you.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional movement and rest in equal measure. Listen to what feels nourishing, not what feels like punishment. This week is about syncing with your natural rhythms, not fighting them.
